description.value: The Vancouver Aquarium is a world-class marine science centre situated in Stanley Park, one of Canada's most celebrated urban parks and a hub for cycling tourism. As the largest aquarium in Canada, it is home to thousands of aquatic animals and is internationally recognized for marine research and conservation. Touring cyclists riding the Stanley Park Seawall or passing through the park will find it a prominent landmark along one of Vancouver's most iconic cycling routes.
